name: we-meet-desktop
description: we-meet 桌面端 (Electron) — 复用 src/frontend 的 React 应用

scripts.test:remote-input: npm run build:remote-input && npm run test:remote-input:cleanup && npm run test:remote-input:keys && tsc && node --test tests/remote-control-native.integration.cjs && python native/remote-input/test_runtime.py -v
scripts.test:remote-control: npm run build:remote-input && npm run test:remote-input:cleanup && npm run test:remote-input:keys && tsc && node --test tests/remote-control-*.integration.cjs tests/remote-control-*.test.cjs && python native/remote-input/test_runtime.py -v
scripts.probe:remote-control:displays: npm run build:remote-input && tsc && electron scripts/remote-control-display-probe.cjs
scripts.test:remote-input:package: npm run build:main && npm run build:remote-input && node scripts/remote-control-package-smoke.cjs
scripts.package: node scripts/verify-electron.mjs && npm run build:main && npm run build:remote-input && npm run build:renderer && npm run copy:renderer && node scripts/verify-renderer.mjs && node scripts/verify-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 && node scripts/release-manifest.mjs
scripts.package:prepared: node scripts/verify-electron.mjs && npm run build:main && npm run build:remote-input && node scripts/verify-renderer.mjs && node scripts/verify-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 && node scripts/release-manifest.mjs
scripts.package:release: npm run build:main && node scripts/release-gate.mjs && npm run build:remote-input && npm run build:renderer && npm run copy:renderer && node scripts/verify-renderer.mjs && node scripts/verify-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.config.cjs --win --x64 && node scripts/release-manifest.mjs --formal
